title: Certify real-time I/O and external-tool calls for newly onboarded models
creator: Aisha Patel
description: When onboarding new model variants we must ensure they behave correctly for streaming responses and for function/tool calling. This ticket defines a verification and certification workflow that produces a published compatibility verdict and a performance profile suitable for version-pinning in customer deployments. The goal is to catch regressions in chunked JSON emission, incremental function-call argument emission, KV cache continuity across streaming reconnects, and any runtime-level kernel scheduling behavior that changes latency tail characteristics.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic test harness can replay a canonical streaming workload against the onboarded model and assert preserved token boundaries and valid partial JSON for function/tool calls

Function/tool calling tests validate that both streaming partials and finalization messages reconstruct to a syntactically valid function call payload and that tooling adapters receive a single well-formed invocation
Performance profile (median, p95, p99 latency; tokens/sec; memory on sample seq lengths) is published to the model catalog entry and matches expected tier within 15%
A version-pinning recommendation is emitted for each model variant (e.g., v1.0.3 pinned for low-latency chat use) and linked in onboarding PR
CI gating: PRs that add new models must include a green verification run or an explicit exemption with an approver comment
steps: Design test vectors that exercise: long-running streams, frequent reconnects, partial JSON function call emission, tool-call handshakes, and high-concurrency bursts
Extend the onboarding harness (infra/tests/onboard_harness) to run streaming verification with configurable seq lengths and chunk sizes
Add adapters in test harness that simulate external tools (webhook, DB writer, file-store) and validate single-invocation semantics
Run the harness across the candidate model variants and collect telemetry: latency distributions, token throughput, memory samples, partial-output validity rate
Publish performance profile to the model catalog entry and add a version_pin recommendation field
Add CI job 'model-onboard-stream-cert' that runs lightweight smoke checks and a nightly extended run for full profiling
Document the certification steps in the onboarding playbook and add console badges to indicate streaming/tool verified models
progress_updates: 2026-02-11: Initial test vectors drafted. Focused on edge cases where partial JSON is split across tokens.
2026-02-14: Harness extension prototype completed; added streaming reconnect simulation and KV-cache continuity checks (branch: feat/stream-cert-harness).
2026-02-18: First run against candidate model 'oas-micro-v2' revealed malformed partial when chunk boundary splits after an escape character. Filed ENG-21480 to track runtime fix.
2026-02-21: Runtime fix for tokenization boundary applied and bench re-run; partial-output validity increased from 84% to 99.2% for the canonical set.
2026-02-25: Draft performance profile published to staging catalog; p95 latency for chat stream on gpus-rt4 is 220ms for 32-token window; needs review by perf team.
2026-02-28: CI job added to platform repo and wired into onboarding PR template. Pending final signoff from Security for tool adapters.
blockers: ENG-21480: runtime tokenization edge-case causing partial JSON corruption
Need security approval for simulated external-tool adapter that performs outbound webhooks to internal staging endpoints
Limited access to a high-concurrency testbed for p99 tail testing during business hours
notes_for_release: Feature gate: streaming-tool-cert must be enabled in staging for the model-catalog updater job
If verification fails for a model variant, onboarding remains allowed but version_pin recommendation is left empty and 'unverified' badge is shown in the console
